mo_ta_cong_viec:
1. Position Objective
Act as a bridge between Business (Finance/Sales/Operations) and Technical teams.
Support the implementation and digitization of key processes such as O2C, P2P, R2R, and CRM.
Ensure business requirements are accurately captured and delivered with guidance from senior team members.
2. Key Responsibilities
Requirements Gathering:
Support collecting and documenting business requirements from stakeholders (Sales/Finance/Warehouse/CS).
Process Analysis & Modeling:
Assist in analyzing current processes (As-Is/To-Be) and creating basic workflows (flowcharts, BPMN).
Documentation:
Prepare and maintain BA documents such as BRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, and simple mockups.
ERP & Accounting Support:
Assist in mapping basic accounting flows (GL/AP/AR) under guidance from senior BA/Accounting team.
CRM Support:
Support defining and documenting CRM flows (lead → opportunity → order).
UAT Support:
Help prepare test cases, support UAT execution, and track bugs/issues.
Integration Support:
Coordinate with technical teams to support integrations (e-invoice, bank, etc.).
Data & Migration:
Support data mapping, data validation, and basic reconciliation tasks.
Training & Documentation:
Assist in preparing user guides, SOPs, and training materials.
yeu_cau:
3. Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, IT, or related fields.
3.5+ years of experience in Business Analysis / ERP / CRM 
Basic understanding of O2C, P2P, R2R processes is a plus.
Fundamental knowledge of accounting concepts (GL/AP/AR) is preferred.
Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodology.
Basic skills in writing user stories, documentation, and process flows.
Good English reading & writing skills.
Strong learning mindset and attention to detail.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Figma, Draw.io is a plus.
4. Nice-to-Have
Exposure to ERP/CRM systems or accounting software.
Basic understanding of IFRS concepts.
Knowledge of SQL for data checking is a plus.
